description.en: Community plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件索引。

description.en: Manage local and project skills with repository installs, update previews, backups, and restoration.
description.zh: 管理本机与项目技能，支持仓库安装、更新预览及备份恢复。

description.en: Customize theme colors and image or video wallpapers with separate opacity and blur controls for interface areas.
description.zh: 自定义主题色与图片或视频壁纸，分别调整各区域的透明度和模糊度。

description.en: Generate session titles from recent user messages while preserving manually assigned titles.
description.zh: 根据会话最近的用户消息生成标题，并保留手动命名。

description.en: Show the current model, account balance or subscription quota, and session or historical spending beneath the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示模型、余额或订阅额度，以及会话与历史费用。

description.en: View 2D and 3D CAD files and use parametric modeling and export tools from a conversation.
description.zh: 在会话中查看二维与三维 CAD 文件，并调用参数化建模与导出工具。

description.en: Connect CalDAV calendars to view, create, reschedule, and import events from DSH.
description.zh: 连接 CalDAV 日历，在会话中查看、创建和调整日程，并导入日历文件。

description.en: Query community plugin assessment records, evidence snapshots, and scoring rules through read-only DSH or MCP tools.
description.zh: 通过只读工具查询社区插件评估记录、证据快照与评分规范。

description.en: Connect eligible ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions through OAuth and view account quotas in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 ChatGPT 与 Codex 订阅模型，并查看账户额度。

description.en: Track session and daily model costs alongside account balances, budgets, and subscription usage.
description.zh: 统计会话与每日模型费用，显示账户余额、预算和订阅套餐用量。

description.en: Store project knowledge in editable Markdown files shared across sessions in the same project.
description.zh: 将项目知识保存为可编辑的 Markdown 文件，供同一项目的多个会话共享。

description.en: Connect multiple mail accounts to send, receive, and search messages with attachments, drafts, and sending approvals.
description.zh: 连接多个邮箱，在会话中收发和搜索邮件，并管理附件、本地草稿与发信审批。

description.en: Adjust conversation, interface, and code typography and save, import, or export presets.
description.zh: 分别调整对话、界面和代码的字体样式，并保存、导入和导出排版预设。

description.en: Zoom, browse, download, and annotate image regions in the DSH conversation viewer.
description.zh: 为会话图片提供缩放、多图浏览、原图下载和区域标注。

description.en: Connect Kimi Code subscription models using API keys or device sign-in, with web search and quota displays.
description.zh: 接入 Kimi Code 订阅模型，支持设备登录、网页搜索和额度查询。

description.en: Keep layered cross-session memories in local SQLite with retrieval, write approvals, and context injection.
description.zh: 以本地 SQLite 保存分层跨会话记忆，提供检索、写入审批和上下文注入。

description.en: Create and read documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the session workspace, and update documents and spreadsheets.
description.zh: 在会话工作区中创建和读取文档、表格与演示文稿，并更新文档和表格。

description.en: Manage OpenCode Go models and multiple accounts with subscription quota displays in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 OpenCode Go 模型与多个账号，并显示订阅额度。

description.en: Turn conversation Markdown headings into a searchable outline with previews and navigation.
description.zh: 把会话中的 Markdown 标题整理为可搜索大纲，支持预览与跳转。

description.en: Browse and toggle skills, diagnose metadata problems, and import or track updates from repositories.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览和开关技能，检查格式问题，并从仓库导入及跟踪更新。

description.en: Discover skills from local directories and Git sources for on-demand loading through DSH or local MCP.
description.zh: 汇总本地与 Git 来源的技能，供 DSH 或本地 MCP 按需加载。

description.en: Add a smoothly moving comet cursor to the chat composer with configurable trails, colors, and thickness.
description.zh: 为聊天输入框添加平滑移动的彗星光标，可调整拖尾、颜色与粗细。

description.en: Register Superpowers development skills and session guidance with the DSH skills and prompt services.
description.zh: 接入 Superpowers 开发技能，并向会话提示词添加使用引导。

description.en: Connect native web search and fetch tools to TinyFish through direct or Monid access.
description.zh: 为网页搜索与抓取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或 Monid 通道。

description.en: Display the current model provider’s balance, subscription quotas, and reset times above the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示当前模型供应商的账户余额、套餐额度及重置时间。

description.en: Search a local Zotero library, read notes and annotations, extract evidence, and generate citations.
description.zh: 检索本地 Zotero 文献库，读取笔记和标注，提取证据并生成引用。

description.en: Keep cross-session memories in local Markdown files and retrieve relevant content for context injection.
description.zh: 将跨会话记忆保存为本地 Markdown 文件，按问题检索并注入相关内容。
